about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Turkish Mercimek Corbasi Red Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: Silky red lentil soup with carrot, onion and paprika butter, the everyday Turkish restaurant starter.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion and carrot for 6 minutes, until softened.
Stir in the tomato paste, cumin and paprika for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lentils, potato and stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes, until the lentils and potato are very soft.
Blend with a stick blender until smooth, adding hot water if too thick, and season with salt.
Serve hot with lemon wedges.
notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge and freezes well.

recipes.title: Turkish Coban Salatasi Shepherd's Salad
recipes.summary: Finely diced tomato, cucumber, pepper and onion with parsley, lemon and olive oil, served with grilled meats.
steps: Combine the tomato, cucumber, capsicum, onion and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk the oil, lemon juice and sumac with a pinch of salt.
Toss through the salad just before serving, until everything is lightly coated and glossy.
notes: Dress at the last minute so the vegetables stay crisp.

recipes.title: Turkish Cacik Cucumber and Mint Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Thick yoghurt with grated cucumber, garlic and dried mint, served as a dip or a cooling soup.
steps: Squeeze the grated cucumber in a clean cloth until quite dry.
Mix with the yoghurt, garlic, mint, lemon juice and a pinch of salt.
Chill for 20 minutes until cold and drizzle with olive oil to serve.
notes: Keeps 2 days in the fridge; stir before serving.

recipes.title: Turkish Muhammara Red Pepper and Walnut Dip
recipes.summary: Roasted red capsicum, walnut and pomegranate molasses dip with a gentle chilli and cumin kick.
steps: Roast the capsicums under a hot grill for 10 minutes, turning, until the skins are blackened and blistered.
Cover in a bowl for 10 minutes, then peel and deseed.
Toast the walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes, until fragrant.
Blend the capsicum, walnuts, breadcrumbs, molasses, oil, garlic, cumin, chilli, lemon and salt to a coarse paste.
Taste and serve with warm flatbread.
notes: Keeps 5 days in the fridge. Contains walnuts and gluten.

recipes.title: Turkish Kuru Fasulye White Bean Stew
recipes.summary: Creamy white beans in a tomato and capsicum paste sauce, Turkey's national comfort dish, served with rice.
steps: Heat the oil and cook the onion for 7 minutes, until golden and soft.
Add the garlic, tomato paste, capsicum paste and paprika and stir for 2 minutes, until the oil separates.
Add the beans, stock and sugar and simmer gently for 30 minutes, until the sauce is thick and the beans are creamy.
Season with salt, scatter with mint and parsley and serve with rice.
notes: Better the next day. Keeps 4 days.

recipes.title: Turkish Yayla Corbasi Warm Yoghurt Soup with Sizzled Paprika Butter
recipes.summary: Silky yoghurt and rice soup finished with sizzled mint butter, mellow, tangy and warming.
steps: Simmer the rice in the stock for 18 minutes, until completely tender.
Whisk the yoghurt, egg yolk and flour until smooth, then whisk in a ladle of hot stock.
Pour the yoghurt mixture back into the pot, whisking constantly, and heat gently for 5 minutes until it thickens and is just steaming, without boiling.
Melt the butter, then add the mint and paprika for 30 seconds until sizzling and fragrant.
Season the soup with salt and swirl the mint butter over to serve.
notes: Food safety: heat the soup until steaming hot throughout so the egg yolk is cooked. Do not boil hard or the yoghurt will split.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Mutabal Smoked Eggplant and Tahini Dip
recipes.summary: Charred eggplant blended with tahini, garlic and lemon, smoky and creamy, a mezze staple.
steps: Pierce the eggplants and roast at 220°C for 30 to 35 minutes, turning once, until the skins are charred and the flesh collapses.
Scoop the flesh into a colander and drain for 10 minutes.
Mash with the tahini, lemon, garlic, yoghurt, cumin and salt until creamy but with some texture.
Spoon into a bowl, drizzle with olive oil and scatter with pomegranate.
notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Shorbat Adas Spiced Lentil Soup
recipes.summary: Golden lentil and cumin soup brightened with lemon, the Levantine winter staple.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add the garlic, cumin and turmeric for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the lentils, carrot and stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 25 minutes, until the lentils are soft.
Blend roughly, leaving some texture, and stir in lemon juice and salt.
Serve with coriander on top.
notes: Keeps 4 days; freezes well.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Hummus Masabacha Warm Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Warm whole chickpeas folded through lemony tahini with olive oil and chilli, a Levantine breakfast.
steps: Warm the chickpeas gently in a pan with a splash of water for 5 minutes, until steaming hot.
Whisk the tahini, lemon, garlic, salt and 3 tbsp water into a loose sauce.
Fold half the sauce through the chickpeas.
Spoon into bowls and top with the remaining sauce, olive oil, cumin, chilli and parsley.
notes: Serve with warm pita. Contains sesame.

recipes.title: Greek Skordalia Garlic Potato Dip
recipes.summary: Pungent garlic and olive oil potato dip served with fried fish, roasted beetroot or crisp vegetables.

items: 500g floury potatoes, peeled and cut up

steps: Boil the potatoes for 15 to 18 minutes, until completely soft, then drain well.
Mash or rice them while hot until smooth.
Beat in the garlic, almonds and vinegar, then slowly beat in the oil until thick and glossy.
Season with salt and serve at room temperature.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge. Contains almonds.

recipes.title: Greek Melitzanosalata Smoky Eggplant Dip
recipes.summary: Charred eggplant dip with garlic, parsley and red wine vinegar.
steps: Roast the eggplants at 220°C for 35 to 40 minutes, turning once, until the skins are black and the flesh is very soft.
Scoop the flesh into a sieve and drain for 10 minutes.
Chop finely and mix with the garlic, oil, vinegar, lemon juice and parsley.
Season with salt and chill until cold.
notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Greek Tirokafteri Whipped Feta and Chilli Dip
recipes.summary: Tangy whipped feta with roasted red pepper and chilli, a fiery Greek meze.

items: 1 roasted red capsicum from a jar, drained

steps: Roughly crumble the feta into a food processor.
Add the yoghurt, capsicum, chilli, olive oil and lemon juice and blend until smooth and creamy.
Taste and add more chilli if you like, then spoon into a bowl and sprinkle with oregano.
notes: Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Greek Revithia Chickpea Soup
recipes.summary: Slow-simmered chickpeas with onion, rosemary and lemon, a Sifnos Sunday tradition.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 7 minutes, until golden.
Add the garlic, bay leaf, rosemary, chickpeas and stock.
Simmer gently for 30 minutes, until the chickpeas are very soft and the broth is slightly creamy.
Remove the herbs, stir in the lemon juice and season with salt.
Serve hot with crusty bread.
notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Italian Panzanella Tuscan Bread and Tomato Salad
recipes.summary: Juicy tomatoes and crisp sourdough cubes tossed with basil, red onion and a punchy vinaigrette.
steps: Toss the bread with 2 tbsp olive oil and bake at 200°C for 8 to 10 minutes, until golden and crisp at the edges.
Combine the tomato, onion, cucumber and capers in a large bowl.
Whisk the remaining oil, vinegar and salt, pour over and toss.
Add the bread and basil and rest for 10 minutes until the bread is just soaked but still chewy.
notes: Best eaten within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Italian Stracciatella Roman Egg Drop Soup
recipes.summary: Rags of egg, parmesan and semolina set in a hot chicken broth, a quick Roman classic.
steps: Bring the stock to a gentle boil until bubbling.
Beat the eggs with the parmesan, semolina, parsley, nutmeg and 2 tbsp cold stock.
Pour into the pot in a thin stream while stirring slowly, and cook for 2 minutes, until the egg sets in thin ragged ribbons.
Season with salt and serve straight away.
notes: Food safety: cook the egg until fully set, with no liquid egg. Parmesan is not vegetarian.

recipes.title: Italian Pappa al Pomodoro Tuscan Tomato Bread Soup
recipes.summary: Thick Tuscan soup of ripe tomatoes, stale bread, garlic and basil, finished with green olive oil.
steps: Warm 2 tbsp oil with the garlic and chilli for 2 minutes, until fragrant but not browned.
Add the tomatoes, crushing them, and the stock and simmer for 15 minutes, until thickened.
Stir in the bread and cook for 8 minutes, until it breaks down into a thick porridge-like soup.
Tear in the basil, season with salt and finish with the remaining oil.
notes: Thickens as it stands; loosen with hot water.

recipes.title: Italian Frittata di Zucchine
recipes.summary: Thick zucchini and cheese frittata, set under the grill and served warm or cold.
steps: Squeeze the zucchini dry and sauté in the oil with the garlic in an ovenproof pan for 5 minutes, until softened.
Beat the eggs with the cheese, basil and salt and pour over.
Cook on low heat for 5 minutes until the edges set, then grill for 3 to 4 minutes until the top is golden and the centre is set with no liquid egg.
Rest 5 minutes and cut into wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook until the egg is fully set with no liquid. Refrigerate within 2 hours and eat within 3 days.

recipes.title: Moroccan Zaalouk Smoky Eggplant and Tomato Salad
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked eggplant and tomato with garlic, cumin and paprika, served warm or cold with bread.
steps: Salt the eggplant for 10 minutes, rinse and pat dry.
Cook the tomatoes, garlic and spices in the oil for 10 minutes, until jammy.
Add the eggplant and 100ml water, cover and simmer for 20 minutes, until completely soft.
Mash roughly with a fork and cook uncovered for 5 minutes until thick, then add lemon juice and coriander.
notes: Keeps 5 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Misir Wot Red Lentil Stew
recipes.summary: Spiced red lentils simmered with onion, garlic, ginger and a berbere-style paprika blend.
steps: Cook the onions dry in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, until soft and starting to colour.
Add the oil, garlic and ginger, then the spices and tomato paste, and stir for 3 minutes until a thick paste forms.
Add the lentils and water, bring to the boil and simmer for 20 minutes, until the lentils are tender and the stew is thick.
Season with salt and serve with injera or rice.
notes: Keeps 4 days and freezes well.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Shiro Wot Chickpea Flour Stew
recipes.summary: Smooth, spiced chickpea flour stew with onion and garlic, an everyday fasting dish.
steps: Cook the onions in a dry pot for 8 minutes, until soft.
Add the oil, garlic, ginger and spices and stir for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Whisk the chickpea flour into the water until no lumps remain and pour into the pot.
Simmer, stirring often, for 15 minutes, until thick, smooth and glossy.
Stir in the lemon juice and salt and serve with injera.
notes: Thickens as it cools; loosen with water. Keeps 4 days.

recipes.title: Ethiopian Gomen Braised Silverbeet and Garlic
recipes.summary: Garlicky, ginger-scented braised greens, a staple beside stews and injera.
steps: Blanch the silverbeet in boiling water for 2 minutes, until wilted, then drain and squeeze.
Cook the onion in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, ginger, chilli and turmeric for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the greens and the water and simmer for 10 minutes, until tender and the liquid has reduced.
Season with salt and taste, adding a squeeze of lemon if you like.
notes: Keeps 3 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Mexican Chilaquiles Rojos
recipes.summary: Crisp tortilla wedges in roasted tomato and chilli salsa, topped with fried eggs and fresh ricotta.
steps: Fry the tortillas in 4 tbsp oil in batches for 2 to 3 minutes, until crisp, and drain on paper towel.
Grill the tomatoes, chillies and garlic for 8 minutes, until charred, then blend with the onion and stock to a smooth salsa.
Simmer the salsa in a wide pan for 5 minutes, until slightly thickened, and season with salt.
Fold in the chips for 1 minute, until just coated but still with some bite.
Fry the eggs in the remaining oil until the whites are set and place on top, then scatter with ricotta, red onion and coriander.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; pregnant, elderly and young people should have the yolks cooked firm.

recipes.title: Mexican Pico de Gallo Fresh Tomato Salsa
recipes.summary: Chunky tomato, onion, coriander and lime salsa, best eaten fresh with chips, tacos and grilled meat.
steps: Mix the tomato, onion, jalapeno and coriander in a bowl.
Stir through the lime juice and salt.
Rest for 10 minutes until the juices run, then taste and adjust.
notes: Best the same day; keeps 2 days in the fridge.

recipes.title: Mexican Frijoles Charros Cowboy Bean Soup
recipes.summary: Pinto beans simmered with smoky bacon, chorizo, tomato and jalapeno, a northern Mexican barbecue staple.
steps: Fry the bacon and chorizo in a pot for 6 minutes, until the fat renders and the meats brown.
Add the onion, garlic, tomatoes and jalapenos and cook for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the beans and stock, bring to the boil and simmer for 30 minutes, until the broth is rich and thickened.
Season with salt, add the coriander and serve in bowls.
notes: Food safety: cook the chorizo until it reaches 75°C throughout and no pink remains. Cool leftovers within 2 hours and use within 3 days.

recipes.title: Colombian Hogao Tomato and Onion Sofrito
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked tomato, spring onion and garlic base that flavours Colombian rice, beans and arepas.
steps: Warm the oil in a pan and cook the brown onion and spring onions for 6 minutes, until soft.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, cumin and sugar and simmer for 12 minutes, until jammy and thick.
Stir in the coriander and salt and serve warm over rice, eggs or arepas.
notes: Keeps 5 days in the fridge or freeze in portions.
